description: Header file defining the InputArchive class for deserializing tensors and other data in PyTorch, including methods for loading from files, streams, and memory, and for reading various data types.

classes.name: InputArchive
classes.description: A class for deserializing tensors and other data from files or streams in PyTorch.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an IValue associated with a key.

methods.name: try_read
methods.description: Attempts to read an IValue or tensor associated with a key, returning false if not found.

methods.name: load_from
methods.description: Loads an InputArchive from a file, stream, or memory buffer, with optional device remapping.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys in the archive.
